scope: HITL-002 public Approval request contract and durable linkage. The golden OpenAPI test and disposable PostgreSQL/MinIO public-process check cover only safe Approval projection fields and their session/turn/tool correlation. Private Broker seeding is test setup only. This is not a sandbox, Firecracker, Linux/KVM, or browser claim.

observations.golden_contract: The closed Approval schema requires the stable approval/session/turn/tool links plus requester, policy revision, safe action, bounded maximum uses, state, and expiry; the action vocabulary and scope bounds are asserted directly.
observations.durable_linkage: The disposable API-process check reads the same caller-owned pending Approval before and after restart through public HTTP/SDK clients and verifies its session, Turn, Tool call, requester, policy, safe action, bounded scope, expiry, and undecided state.
observations.legacy_safety: Historic snapshots missing an original safe action summary fail closed on durable store and public SDK reads; the runtime never invents a public action from opaque digests.

redaction: No DSNs, object-store credentials, tokens, raw tenant/session/turn/approval IDs, descriptors, capability values, credentials, grants, backend handles, or provider credentials are retained.
